blocks.text: Point tracking aims to follow any query point through a video. Formally, given a query point $\mathbf{q}=(x,y)$ at frame $t_0$, the tracker predicts a trajectory $\{\mathbf{p}_t\}_{t=1}^{T}$ with visibility flags $v_t \in \{0,1\}$.
The overall pipeline is shown in Figure 1.
Figure 1: **Demo pipeline.** Features are extracted per frame and correlated with the query point.
Our method improves the average Jaccard (AJ) by 6.3 points over the baseline.
